A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that
UCN lifetimes in SD2 are comparable to the lifetimes measured for UCNs stored in superfluid helium, and that the UCN lifetime in SD2 is sensitive to thermal up-scatter.
the UCN lifetime is limited by the thermal up-scatter rate and is not sensitive to the ortho-to-para conversion rate.
